newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices ease on low overseas buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices ease on low overseas buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices lost gained ground on Wednesday, falling to 1,167/1,168 rupees from 1,178/1,179 rupees on sluggish overseas buying, dealers said.
They said increased new crop arrivals also prompted bull liquidation at higher levels. Arrivals of new crop castorseed in the Gujarat region was high at 20-25,000 bags.(75 kg each).

Groundnut oil was steady at 340/341 rupees per 10 kg on arrivals of 60/70 tonnes while physical buying was sluggish. Rajkot spot oil rose by five rupees to 520/525 per 15 kg on renewed buying by state-owned National Dairy Development Board.
